title: query --at: endorsed emails held at TIME from git history
description: Mark 2026-10-23 chose (a): git vouch query --at TIME judges the person's endorsed emails as of TIME from the registry's git history, as faq3.11 already does for tiers (held_at, git-vouch ~2037 ponytail). Today an endorsement added after TIME counts at TIME: carol endorsed after T0 -> bridge authorized=true at T0. DESIGN TRQP Time says 'emails held then'. An endorsement counts at TIME only if its record was committed at or before TIME and was not removed/revoked by TIME; also respect endorser key validity at TIME consistently with how tiers are judged. Blocks committing vouch-faq3.4.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-written tests (tests/test_query.py and tests/trqp): carol endorsed after T0 -> no endorsed email and authorized=false at T0, true now; endorsement removed after T0 -> counts at T0, not now; existing tests unchanged and green on 3.12 and 3.9; ruff clean; DESIGN line consistent.
